FY26-27.statusDetail: The Board of Commissioners unanimously approved the FY2026-2027 budget on May 18, 2026. This explorer focuses on the $15.0M General Fund within the Town's $33.3M all-funds budget.
highlights: Adopted General Fund budget of $15.0M, an 8.2% increase over FY25-26
The Town's adopted all-funds budget totals $33.3M across five funds
Property tax rate remains at $0.54 per $100 assessed value
Police is the largest operating department at $3.29M
Water and Sewer Fund totals $17.59M during the Tri-River Water transition
General Fund uses $827,294 of appropriated fund balance

timeline.event: Public hearing and unanimous budget adoption
